entities.title: Native adapters (utv::interop)
entities.summary: The conversions between UTV values and SystemTime (always) and chrono's types (feature chrono), as public functions and From/TryFrom impls.
consumers: Application developers' code that holds SystemTime or chrono values
The example suites in implementations/rust/tests, which compare UTV with chrono through them
guarantees: utv::interop::from_system_time and to_system_time, and SystemTime: TryFrom<Instant>, are always available.

With the feature chrono: from_naive_date, from_naive_time, from_naive_date_time, from_fixed_offset(dt, OffsetIntent), from_utc, from_local and to_naive_date, to_naive_time, to_naive_date_time, to_fixed_offset, to_utc in utv::interop::chrono, plus From/TryFrom between NaiveDate, NaiveTime, NaiveDateTime, DateTime<FixedOffset>, DateTime<Utc> and the typed values.
JSON-layer results and refusals carry the operation name convert; typed errors are Diagnostics.
Nothing converts from DateTime<Local>; from_local always answers unsupported (local-zone).
A conversion back to a native type is exact or refused: out-of-native-range, precision-loss or zone-dropped.
entities.compatibility: Part of the crate's 0.x API (see the crate contract): it may change in a minor version, and the CHANGELOG records each change. The chrono dependency is declared as chrono 0.4.38 or later within 0.4.
